translations.title: Loratadine 10 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for allergic rhinitis (sneezing, a blocked nose, itching and burning eyes) and for long-lasting hives with no known cause.
translations.usage: Adults and children 12 or older take one tablet (10 mg) once a day. Children aged 6 to under 12 take one tablet once a day if they weigh 30 kg or more, or half a tablet once a day if they weigh under 30 kg.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you are a child under 6, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you have an inherited condition such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have liver problems or kidney failure. Do not take it together with medicines that slow down liver metabolism, such as cimetidine, erythromycin or ketoconazole.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Allergic rhinitis (sneezing, blocked nose, itching), long-lasting hives
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Under 6; pregnancy and breastfeeding; liver problems
summaryTable.Why this one: An antihistamine taken once a day
